title: The Taste of Home
description: Tang Wen, a researcher from Liyue, seems to be missing home a lot...

mainQuestExcel.title: The Taste of Home
mainQuestExcel.description: Tang Wen, a researcher from Liyue, seems to be missing home a lot...

dialogs.text: Ahh, it would be nice to have some Liyue cuisine...
Are you alright?
You are? With that outfit... You're the Traveler, right? Sorry, I'm just a little homesick...
Did you just say you wanted to have some Liyue cuisine?
Huh? Could it be... You know how to make Liyue cuisine? That's great!
Th-Then, please help me! Please make me some authentic Liyue dishes!
Let me think... What I really want to eat now is...
Hmm... I want to eat fish! I miss the fish my mom made when I was a kid...
Wash the fish, make slashes on both sides, stuff with spices and aged wine and marinate slightly, fry in a pan until golden brown...
Then, add hot water and sauce to simmer. Finally, season over high heat, thicken the sauce, plate, and serve... Ah, that's the real deal!
My younger brother would jump and cheer "It's ready! The food's ready!"
*sobs* My mom is really good at cooking fish, but when can I go back to eat it?
Do you need help with anything?
Let me introduce myself. I'm Tang Wen, a historian from Liyue. I was previously doing some field research on the unique customs and folklore of Inazuma.
I was about to return to Liyue as I had almost finished collecting information. But because of Inazuma's Sakoku Decree, I ended up being stranded here for a long time...
Actually, I think this is kind of a good thing for me. It's because I feel that this is a historic moment for Inazuma!
I am quite sure that this particular period will certainly leave a strong mark in the annals of history of Teyvat.
To witness such history with one's own eyes, and then record all of it in a true, complete and clear manner for posterity, is what a historian should do.
But... as exciting as this cause is to me, it won't satisfy my stomach...
Are you getting hungry?
I can't say... it's because I'm hungry... Hahaha, Inazuma's food is quite tasty too.
I really like the tempura here, although it feels like everything is coated with batter and then fried...
But after eating Inazuma cuisine for a long time, I started to miss the Liyue dishes. Sadly, I couldn't find a restaurant that could make authentic Liyue cuisine.
I finally decided to post a Cuisine Commission at the Adventurers' Guild a few days ago but there hasn't been any response...
Can I give it a try?
Ahh, it would be nice to have some Liyue cuisine about now...
What's the matter?
Huh, that outfit... You're the Traveler, aren't you? I'm sorry, I'm just feeling a little homesick right now...
Did you just say you wanted to have some Liyue cuisine?
Huh? Wait... You know how to make Liyue cuisine? That's great!
Th—Then, please help me! Please make me some authentic Liyue dishes!
Let me think... What I'd really like to eat right now is...
Hmm... I want to eat fish! I miss the fish my mom made when I was a kid...
She'd wash the fish, make slashes on both sides, stuff it with spices and aged wine and marinate slightly, fry it in a pan until golden brown...
Then, she'd add hot water and sauce to simmer, before finally seasoning over high heat, thickening the sauce, plating, and serving... Ah, that's the real deal!
My younger brother would jump and cheer "It's ready! The food's ready!"
*sobs* My mom is really good at cooking fish, but when can I go back to eat it?
Do you need help with anything?
Ah, right. Allow me to me introduce myself. I'm Tang Wen, a historian from Liyue. Previously, I was doing some field research on the unique customs and folklore of Inazuma.
I'd finished collecting all the material I needed, in fact, and was preparing to head back to Liyue. But so many big things have happened in Inazuma recently...
So I feel like I'm living in historic times here, you know?
The happenings of this particular period will certainly leave a strong mark in the annals of Teyvat's history.
To witness such history with one's own eyes, and then record all of it in a true, complete, and clear manner for posterity — that is what a historian should do.
But... as exciting as this cause is to me, it won't satisfy my stomach...
Hungry, are we?
Well, I wouldn't say that exactly... Inazuma's food is actually pretty tasty.
I really like the tempura here, although it's, well... They just wrap everything in batter and fry it, you know?
But after eating Inazuman cuisine for a long time, I started to miss dishes from back home. Sadly, I couldn't find a restaurant here that could make authentic Liyue cuisine.
So I finally decided to post a "cuisine commission" at the Adventurers' Guild a few days ago, but there hasn't been any response since...
May I give it a try?
So, which dish should we prepare that is cooked with fish? How about we choose one for her?
Let's see... Paimon's favorite fish dishes lately are...
Spicy Black-Back Perch Stew!
Sweet and sour Squirrel Fish!
And the almighty Mondstadt Grilled Fish!
Aren't these all your favorite food?
Hehe, just trust in Paimon's taste! Hurry and choose one~
Black-Back Perch Stew then.
Sounds great! Let's quickly make Black-Back Perch Stew for Miss Tang Wen!
Squirrel Fish then.
Yay! Let's quickly make Squirrel Fish for Miss Tang Wen!
Mondstadt Grilled Fish then.
Nice! Let's quickly make Mondstadt Grilled Fish for Miss Tang Wen!
Let me think again...
Hmm, let's make the dish for Miss Tang Wen after deciding!

flow.stepDescription: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogs.text: Back so soon? You're not a secret chef, are you?
Hmmm... I can't wait, please let me try it!
Please enjoy.
Let's see... What dishes did we talk about just now?
Oh right... Squirrel Fish, Black-Back Perch Stew, and Mondstadt Grilled Fish!
Let's decide and give it to Miss Tang Wen!

flow.stepDescription: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogs.text: Ah! This is it! This, this is the taste of home I've been dreaming of... It's... *sob* I'm so touched...
Thank you so much! I feel energized with all this good food.
These are for you. I wish you a smooth journey ahead!

flow.stepDescription: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogs.text: Hmm, this taste... well, it doesn't seem to taste like a Liyue or Inazuma dish. The taste is really new to me...
Although it isn't the cuisine I wanted to eat, I'm already satisfied to be able to taste such a novel dish.
Thank you, Traveler. Please accept these.

flow.stepDescription: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogs.text: Eh? I think this is still an Inazuma dish...
I don't think this is the dish I asked for... Well, never mind, this dish is also filling...
Thanks anyway, Traveler. Please take these.

flow.stepDescription: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogs.text: Hmm? Why does th—this dish taste... so... so interesting.
Can't say it's interesting... Uhh, I should say...unique, or something...
How did you come up with such a dish? Your cooking skills are really...out of this world...
Thanks for your hard work! Traveler, please take these. I'll umm, savor this dish later...
